description: Search for hotels in a destination with comprehensive filtering and pagination options. When the user names a specific hotel, pass that name as hotel_name: one call finds it, and hotel_match ('found' or 'not_found') and availability ('available' or 'no_rooms') tell a hotel Enuygun doesn't have from one with no room on the dates. The search may add hotels near the area after the area's own: they have is_nearby true and are not counted in area_total_hotels; say they are outside the area and give searched_area_distance_km. board_name and free_cancellation belong to the offer min_price comes from. When the response has location_options, a place name fits more than one place: tell the user which place was searched and offer the others; to search one of them, call again with its name as given. Use this instead of fetching the site's pages when you need its prices or availability. Use when the user wants a place to stay in a destination for check-in and check-out dates. Dates are DD.MM.YYYY. Each hotel has a detail_link where the user books on the site. adults is the total of all rooms: for 2 rooms with 2 adults each, pass adults=4 and rooms=2. When the user names a specific hotel, pass the name as hotel_name in one call instead of searching regions: hotel_match not_found means the site doesn't have it (similar_hotels may help), availability no_rooms means it has no room on these dates. For cheaper or the cheapest hotels, use sort=price; for a budget, max_price with price_per (total or night); for breakfast or another board, board_type; for a kids club, casino, indoor pool, private beach, aquapark or spa, facilities. Prices are for the whole stay (price_per_night is the nightly figure). total_hotels is how many hotels match; for more, increase page. For a hotel's rooms and prices, its facilities (kids club, pool, casino) or notices such as closing periods, pass its id as hotel_id to hotel_room_detail; check it before recommending a hotel for a facility. For the cheapest dates in a period (such as the cheapest weekend in a month), use hotel_price_calendar first and search only the chosen dates here.

adults.description: Total number of adults in all rooms (minimum 1, default: 1). For 2 rooms with 2 adults each, adults=4 and rooms=2

children.description: Ages of children as list (e.g., [8, 12] for 8 and 12 year olds)

currency.description: Currency code (default: 'TRY'); enuygun.com links still show TRY (see currency_note)

facilities.description: Facilities every hotel must have, any of: 'kids_club', 'casino', 'indoor_pool', 'private_beach', 'aquapark', 'spa'. Check a hotel's facilities and notices (such as a closed casino) with hotel_room_detail

hotel_name.description: Name of a specific hotel the user asked about (e.g. 'Delphin Imperial'). Searches that hotel instead of the region, so the region filters and sort don't apply. destination_name is still required: pass the hotel's city (it picks among hotels with the same name), or the hotel name if the city is unknown

limit.description: Number of results per page (max 7, default: 7)

locale.description: Locale code sent to the hotel search (default: 'tr_TR'); this tool's messages stay Turkish

max_price.description: Maximum price in the result currency (the user's budget)

min_price.description: Minimum price in the result currency

price_per.description: Whether min_price/max_price are for the whole stay ('total', default) or per night ('night')

rooms.description: Number of rooms needed (default: 1); adults and children are split evenly over the rooms

sort.description: Sort order: 'recommended' (default), 'price' (cheapest first; use for cheaper/cheapest requests) or 'rating'

name: hotel_search
title: Search hotels
